Keyboard shortcuts
Create
Tab · double-click canvasQuick add: search nodes and commands
1 2 3 4Add Text · LLM · Image · Video at the cursor
UUpload image / video / audio files (or drag and drop, or Ctrl+V an image)
SNew sequence frame at the cursor — wraps the selection if nodes are selected
Ctrl+GWrap selected nodes in a sequence
Right-clickContext menu: add nodes, link, run, sequence actions
Select & transform
V · HMarquee-select mode · pan mode
Ctrl/Shift + drag canvasMarquee select in any mode (adds to selection)
Ctrl/Shift + click · Alt + clickToggle node in selection · select whole chain
Ctrl+ASelect all
Drag any of the 8 handlesScale a node / sequence and its contents proportionally; no Shift required
Double-click a handleReset size
Arrow keys (+Shift)Nudge 10px (50px)
Edit
Ctrl+Z · Ctrl+YUndo · redo
Ctrl+C Ctrl+V Ctrl+X Ctrl+DCopy · paste at cursor · cut · duplicate (sequences include their nodes)
DeleteDelete selection (deleting a sequence keeps its nodes)
Ctrl+SSave now (autosave is always on)
Link
Drag right port → nodeLink (drop anywhere on the target node) · drop on empty canvas = new linked node
Drag left portPick up the nearest incoming link
L · LLLink selection to… menu · link straight to the last selected node
View & navigate
Wheel · Space+drag · middle dragZoom at cursor · pan
F · Ctrl+0 · +/−Fit selection or all · 100% · zoom in/out
Click · double-click · Enter · EscClick opens a node for editing · drag moves it · Enter also opens · Esc or a click outside closes it
RReview: approve waiting reference images with keys 1–4 · R again · W rewrite · ←/→ move
ISystem documents: the standing instructions every AI call reads
KReference library: the folders the Reference Agent draws reference pictures from
TTidy layout: arranges the selected nodes (2 or more), the selected sequence, or the whole canvas left → right along the links · Ctrl+Z undoes it
ECollapse / expand the selected nodes (nothing selected = all nodes)
Shift+SSequence outline
Ctrl+OProjects (series & episodes)
Alt+← · Alt+→Previous · next episode
A · J · C · ?Automation: lays the whole pipeline out on the workspace, already wired · chat assistant · cost dashboard · this sheet
Shift+JChat size: docked → wide → full screen
In chat: Alt+T · Alt+W · Alt+1…9 · Ctrl+PgUp/PgDnNew tab · close tab · go to tab · previous / next tab (middle-click a tab to close, drag to reorder)
Ctrl+E (in a text field)Open the prompt editor: find/replace, @references, AI edit, library, history
Inside text fields, Ctrl+Z / C / V act on the text. Click the canvas to use workspace shortcuts. Undo never deletes generated media.
